LanguageData.SCP_055CargoNoPost: A free standard containment post is required in the reserve chamber.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoPostOccupied: The post cell holds another item or has another object assigned. Clear the post.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoNoPath: The post work cell is unreachable or reserved by another job.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoNoCarrier: No available carrier. Check access, reservations and drafted colonists.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoRoomNotClosed: The post must be inside an enclosed room.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoRoomSmall: The post room is too small: {0} cells, at least {1} required.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoRoofMissing: The room roof is incomplete: {0} unroofed cells.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoNeedRoom: Prepare a free containment post in a fully roofed enclosed room of at least 25 cells, with concrete or Foundation walls and a Foundation two-cell armored door. Do not hold the door open.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoArrivedBody: The Foundation delivered a wooden crate for the reserve chamber. Its paperwork says only: "Move to a containment post. Research after placement." The contents field is blank.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoInspect: Paperwork attached. No information about the contents. Move to a containment post in a prepared reserve chamber.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoMoveDesc: Select an employee to carry the crate to a free post in a prepared reserve chamber and complete receipt. Its contents are studied separately.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoPlacedBody: The cargo is in its chamber. The paperwork is signed, but contains no description of its contents. The employee who completed receipt cannot explain what was delivered. Assign a researcher to the post for further work.
LanguageData.SCP_055CargoRegistered: Receipt completed. Further records are available through the containment post.
